question: measures for authenticating access to systems
answer: The organization enforces Single Sign-On (SSO) via Okta for all corporate and production systems, with SSO configured with SAML 2.0 and supporting OIDC for modern applications. Additionally, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) is mandatory for all users across all systems without exception, with approved methods including hardware security keys, Okta Verify push notifications, and time-based one-time passwords. For systems that do not yet support SSO or for service accounts, password complexity rules are enforced, including a minimum length of 14 characters, and containing at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one number, and one special character. Passwords expire and must be rotated every 90 days, with password reuse for the last 5 passwords automatically blocked.
